purpose: Explicitly prevent pre-review research targets from being mistaken for validated claims in the active Nature Communications revision.
decision_rule: A legacy target is not carried forward merely because its ledger said MET. It must be supported by the active source package, preserve the current interface and split semantics, and belong to the correct evidence class. Otherwise it is marked not transferred, adverse, withdrawn or author-confirmation pending.
